EvidenceBody: Chan records repeatedly couple it with results said to occur without going elsewhere: liberation 'right where it is,' arising right there and appearing wherever one goes, quiescence right there, and the place of teaching right there. In public exchanges it also retains its direct locative force: when a visitor quotes 'without leaving the very place, constantly clear,' the identified master is asked where that is. Another discourse asks how one recognizes the buddhas and immediately surpasses them right there. These predicates and questions load an ordinary locative expression within Chan discourse.
